incident_soul_bible_wipe.what_happened: First append attempt used [System.IO.File]::Open(FileMode.Create, FileShare.ReadWrite) on the source-of-truth file while a concurrent lock holder was active. FileMode.Create truncated the target to 0 bytes; the write did not durably persist. File became EMPTY (0 bytes, 2056 entries lost from working tree).
incident_soul_bible_wipe.recovery: File is git-tracked. git status showed 'MM' = index (staged) still held the 1,080,281-byte / 2056-entry version. Recovered via 'git restore CANON/SOUL/BIBLE-OF-THE-SYSTEM.json' (working tree from index). Verified 2056 entries parse OK. Quote re-appended via temp-file + atomic Move-Item + verify-after-write + retry. Now 2057 entries, verified.
incident_soul_bible_wipe.root_cause: FileMode.Create truncates immediately; unsafe against a live lock holder on a source-of-truth file. No verify-after-write on first attempt.
incident_soul_bible_wipe.fix_applied: Use temp-file write + atomic Move-Item + re-read verification + retry loop. Never FileMode.Create a live source-of-truth under a lock.
